title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
description: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

title: The Other Lamb
description: A young woman born into an all-female cult begins to question the teachings of her leader.

title: Swallow
description: A young housewife in a seemingly perfect marriage develops pica, the irresistible urge to ingest inedible objects and material.

title: The Other Man
description: After his wife Lisa disappears on a business trip, Peter finds evidence that she has been having an affair with Ralph. He flies to Milan and enters into a complicated charade by befriending Ralph and slowly teasing information about Lisa out of him.

title: The Last Thing Mary Saw
description: In the spring of 1840, a family gathers in their old, isolated farm house to mourn the loss of their matriarch. As the mourning proceeds, the circumstances of the matriarch's death come into question.

title: The Beta Test
description: A married Hollywood agent receives a mysterious letter for an anonymous sexual encounter and becomes ensnared in a sinister world of lying, murder and infidelity.

title: Dog Eat Dog
description: Three ex-cons (Nicolas Cage, Willem Dafoe, Christopher Matthew Cook) find themselves on the run from the mob and the police after botching a plan to kidnap a baby for a large ransom.

title: The Owners
description: An elderly couple turn the tables on a group of young thieves who broke into their house while they were away.

title: Impetigore
description: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she is unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

title: Dead Mail
description: A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.

title: Night of the Hunted
description: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

title: I Sell the Dead
description: Before he is executed, Arthur Blake relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls to a priest.

title: Freeway Killer
description: Californian serial killer William Bonin (Scott Anthony Leet) searches for victims on the state's highways.

title: Spree
description: Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.

title: A Wounded Fawn
description: A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

title: Desolation
description: When a widow ventures into a remote wilderness area with her son and best friend to spread her husband's ashes, a mysterious hiker begins dogging them and forces them to confront their deepest fears.

title: The Postcard Killings
description: A New York detective investigates the death of his daughter, who was murdered while on her honeymoon in London, the victim of an apparent serial killer.

title: Welcome to Willits
description: Locals in the California woods are attacked by supernatural creatures, and when the situation escalates into carnage, a farmer struggles to defend his family.

title: What Keeps You Alive
description: Venomous betrayals engulf a female married couple attempting to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: Watcher
description: As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.

description: Psychics (Paul Le Mat, Irene Miracle, Matt Roe) at a bay hotel meet the puppets Pin Head, Leech Woman, Tunneler, Blade and Jester.

description: A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.

title: ATM
description: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

title: Beneath the Darkness
description: Teenagers discover a terrible secret when they break into the home of a mortician whose wife died two years earlier.

title: Almost Human
description: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

title: Bone Tomahawk
description: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

title: Trick
description: A detective tries to track down a masked killer who reappears every Halloween to wreak bloody havoc.

title: VFW
description: A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into a battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar. When a gang of punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect themselves from an unrelenting attack.

title: Trespassers
description: Two couples rent a luxury home for the weekend, hoping to sort out their messed-up lives. Just as they are about to settle in for a fun night, a neighbor turns up at their door and claims she has car trouble. And that's when the terror really starts.

title: Stranded
description: Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.
